attractions.name: Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood
attractions.description: Historic 19th-century district with traditional wind towers, narrow lanes, art galleries, and cultural museums.

attractions.name: Dubai Creek Traditional Abra Crossing
attractions.description: Iconic traditional motorized wooden boat crossing between Bur Dubai and Deira spice and gold markets.

attractions.name: Deira Gold & Spice Souk
attractions.description: Vibrant traditional Arabian bazaars offering hundreds of gold jewelry shops, aromatic spices, and perfumes.

attractions.name: Al Shindagha Museum & Perfume House
attractions.description: World-class open-air heritage museum chronicling the nation's maritime trade, governance, and traditional perfumery.

attractions.name: Al Seef Heritage Waterfront
attractions.description: Charming riverside destination blending rustic traditional Emirati heritage architecture with modern dining.

attractions.name: Sheikh Mohammed Centre for Cultural Understanding (SMCCU)
attractions.description: Interactive cultural center hosting traditional Emirati breakfasts, lunches, and open cross-cultural conversations.

attractions.name: Dubai Museum & Al Fahidi Fort
attractions.description: Housed within Dubai's oldest existing building (built 1787), showcasing pre-oil life, pearl diving, and desert weapons.

attractions.name: Bur Dubai Textile Souk
attractions.description: Traditional covered bazaar packed with vibrant rolls of silk, pashminas, hand-woven fabrics, and custom tailors.

attractions.name: Heritage House & Al Ahmadiya School
attractions.description: Dubai's first formal school established in 1912, restored with historical classrooms and period pearl merchant houses.

attractions.name: Coffee Museum Dubai
attractions.description: Boutique heritage museum celebrating regional and Ethiopian coffee culture, antique grinders, and traditional brewing.

attractions.name: Museum of Illusions Dubai
attractions.description: Playful optical illusion wonderland situated on the Al Seef waterfront featuring vortex tunnels and anti-gravity rooms.

attractions.name: Deira Clocktower
attractions.description: Iconic mid-century roundabout landmark erected in 1963 symbolising Dubai's early trade and gateway to Deira.

attractions.name: Burj Khalifa — At The Top (Levels 124 & 125)
attractions.description: Observation deck of the world's tallest building, offering 360-degree panoramic views of Dubai's skyline and desert.

attractions.name: Museum of the Future
attractions.description: Architectural marvel featuring immersive exhibits on space exploration, bioengineering, and near-future technologies.

attractions.name: The Dubai Mall & Aquarium Underwater Zoo
attractions.description: Massive retail hub housing a 10-million-liter suspended aquarium tank with thousands of marine animals.

attractions.name: The Dubai Fountain Show
attractions.description: Captivating choreographed musical water fountain show set on the 30-acre Burj Lake against the Burj Khalifa.

attractions.name: Sky Views Dubai Observatory & Glass Slide
attractions.description: Glass-bottomed observation walkway and transparent glass slide linking twin towers 219 meters above ground.

attractions.name: Dubai Frame (Zabeel Park)
attractions.description: 150-meter-tall golden rectangular frame framing Old Dubai to the north and futuristic New Dubai to the south.

attractions.name: Dubai Opera
attractions.description: 2,000-seat multi-format performing arts center shaped like a traditional Arabian dhow vessel.

attractions.name: Souk Al Bahar & Boardwalk
attractions.description: Arabesque dining and shopping marketplace connected via footbridge to Dubai Mall with unobstructed fountain views.

attractions.name: DIFC Gate Village Art Galleries
attractions.description: Dubai's financial center cultural quarter housing prestigious contemporary Middle Eastern and international art galleries.

attractions.name: The Green Planet Bio-Dome (City Walk)
attractions.description: Enclosed tropical rainforest bio-dome hosting over 3,000 plants and animals around a giant artificial kapok tree.

attractions.name: Dubai Marina Walk
attractions.description: Scenic 7-kilometer palm-lined waterfront promenade fringed by luxury yachts, cafes, and illuminated skyscrapers.

attractions.name: The Beach at JBR & The Walk
attractions.description: Popular public sandy beach destination with changing facilities, watersports, beach volleyball, and an open-air mall.

attractions.name: Bluewaters Island & Ain Dubai Plaza
attractions.description: Modern urban island accessible via a scenic 265-meter pedestrian bridge from JBR, offering dramatic coastal views.

attractions.name: Madame Tussauds Dubai
attractions.description: Celebrity wax museum on Bluewaters Island featuring regional Arab leaders, movie stars, musicians, and sports icons.

attractions.name: Dubai Marina Mall Promenade
attractions.description: Boutique waterfront shopping and dining complex connected directly to the Dubai Tram and Dubai Ferry.

attractions.name: Skydive Dubai Marina Dropzone (Viewing Area)
attractions.description: Vibrant coastal dropzone cafe viewing area where visitors watch parachutists landing with Palm Jumeirah in the background.

attractions.name: The View at The Palm (Level 52)
attractions.description: 240-meter-high observatory providing an unparalleled 360-degree panorama of the entire Palm Jumeirah archipelago.

attractions.name: Souk Madinat Jumeirah
attractions.description: Atmospheric bazaar recreation with internal waterways, traditional abras, handicraft shops, and waterfront restaurants.

attractions.name: Kite Beach (Jumeirah)
attractions.description: Dubai's favorite active beach, boasting soft sands, running tracks, food trucks, and iconic Burj Al Arab sunset views.

attractions.name: Palm West Beach Boardwalk
attractions.description: 1.6-kilometer beachside promenade on the trunk of the Palm with pristine waters, shaded cabanas, and Dubai Marina views.

attractions.name: Atlantis Aquaventure Waterpark
attractions.description: Massive record-breaking waterpark featuring over 105 slides, private beach access, and marine animal experiences.

attractions.name: The Lost Chambers Aquarium (Atlantis)
attractions.description: Underwater halls and passages themed around the lost city of Atlantis, housing 65,000 marine animals.

attractions.name: Burj Al Arab Jumeirah Public Sunset Viewpoint
attractions.description: Public beachfront vista offering world-famous unobstructed views of the iconic sail-shaped Burj Al Arab hotel.

attractions.name: Jumeirah Mosque
attractions.description: Only mosque in Dubai open to non-Muslim visitors 6 days a week, built in medieval Fatimid architectural style.

attractions.name: Dubai Miracle Garden
attractions.description: World's largest natural flower garden displaying 150 million blooming flowers formed into life-sized sculptures (Nov-May).

attractions.name: Global Village Dubai
attractions.description: Vast multicultural theme park showcasing pavilions from 90+ cultures, street performances, and global cuisine (Oct-Apr).

attractions.name: Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve Heritage Drive
attractions.description: Protected desert ecosystem with rolling sand dunes, Arabian oryx sightings, and traditional sunset camps.

attractions.name: Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary (Flamingo Hide)
attractions.description: Urban wetland reserve serving as a critical haven for tens of thousands of migratory birds, notably pink flamingos.

attractions.name: Dubai Safari Park
attractions.description: Expansive 119-hectare eco-friendly wildlife sanctuary housing 3,000 animals across African, Asian, and Arabian villages.

attractions.name: Ski Dubai Snow Park (Mall of the Emirates)
attractions.description: Sub-zero indoor mountain snow park spanning 22,500 square meters with ski slopes, toboggans, and live gentoo penguins.
